caption: A bad connection in a fuse box sparks and pops, and the lights in the house go out.

sa.check: A fuse box with its lid open or its connections in view.
A connection in the box sparks.
The lights in the house go out.
The lights are lit before the spark.
The spark comes first and the lights go out after.

pc.expect: The spark is a brief flash at one connection in the box, and is gone; it does not stay lit or spread across the box.
pc.fail: The spark glows on at the connection for the rest of the clip; or several connections flash one after another; or the whole box glows; or a spark appears again after the lights are already out.

pc.expect: The lights go out at the spark and stay out; they do not come back on by themselves.
pc.fail: The spark flashes and the lights stay lit to the end of the clip; or the lights go out before the spark; or the lights come back on by themselves; or the lights flicker on and off repeatedly.

pc.expect: The light the lamps cast disappears with them: the room around the box goes dim and whatever remains lit is daylight or the spark.
pc.fail: A lamp goes dark while its light on the walls stays; or the room stays as bright with every lamp dark; or a lamp elsewhere brightens as the others go out.

pc.expect: Any spark fragments fall from the box and go dark within a short distance; any smoke rises.
pc.fail: Sparks rise from the box and gather above it; or hang in the air; or smoke sinks from the box and pools on the floor.

pc.expect: One fuse box on the wall; its parts stay in place; nothing appears, vanishes or passes through the wall.
pc.fail: The box vanishes or a second box appears; or fuses or wires appear or vanish; or the box sinks into the wall; or the box changes shape.

pc.expect: The box's colour and labels and the wall stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The box changes colour; or the labels change; or the wall changes colour rather than brightness.

note: The pop is sound and is not judged.
